propositions: Agentic runs waste 40-70% of request budget repeating identical tool calls (144x search_files, 62x on deterministic '(no matches)') because each duplicate re-executes and re-pays the round-trip.
The shipped windowed distinct-ratio actuator in agent_call.py correctly aborts pathological runs but acts as backstop only; no upstream memoization prevents waste before trip point.

A memoize+nudge wrapper at the agent-call seam must return cached results for duplicate allowlisted read-only calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) with escalating nudge text, while leaving error results (Error: -prefixed strings) unmemoized to allow retry.

Error results identified by 'Error:' prefix must re-execute on identical retry; deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' are stable, memoizable answers that eliminate the core 62x-loop waste.
The runaway guard must still observe every duplicate call signature in its distinct-ratio window regardless of memoization, maintaining trip-point invariants unchanged.
Wrapper layering order (guard outermost, memo middle, steering inner) preserves guard call-signature observation semantics while allowing memo short-circuit before tool execution.
